title: D3-Mandates
tagline: Automated strategic investment tool for web3 degens. A DCA module built for 4337 compliant SCWs.
description:
Our protocol can be used to make automatic investments in DeFi. By subscribing to various DeFi strategies on our dashboard, users can make automatic monthly investments, do DCA investments, automatically copy other expert trader's positions (such as if 5 expert traders buy a particular coin), application can make an automatic trade into the said coin). Currently the 7M DeFi traders do not have any easy way to do web2 like systematic investments. The automatic investment methods currently present in the web3 market are all custodial solutions that pose serious security risks.

how_its_made: 1Inch Fusion SDK does not have support for smart contract wallets which made it impossible for us to use it for swapping SCW assets on the back. Hence we decided to use Uniswap contracts to make these swaps happen.
